summary.tldr: Bars the foreign affairs minister from making trade commitments that raise import quotas or lower tariffs on dairy, poultry, and eggs.
what_it_does: Adds a rule to the Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development Act that limits what the Minister can promise in international trade deals.
Stops the Minister from agreeing to raise the tariff rate quota, an import limit, for dairy products, poultry, or eggs.
Stops the Minister from agreeing to lower the tariff on those goods when imports go over the quota.
who_it_affects: Importers of dairy, poultry and eggs
summary.background: The bill changes section 10 of the Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development Act. It adds limits on trade commitments for certain supply-managed goods.
